name: Valuation Cross-Company Acceptance

RANGE_ONLY.rule: Use when the validated driver forecast, forward share bridge, and independent cross-check are not all present.

required: At least one validated independent valuation cross-check.
Validated S09 horizon and Base-Case Return contract.

raw_first_run.interpretation: The raw first run preserved six fixture-assembly failures, three probability-persistence assembly failures, and three shared valuation-status defects.

shared_defects: Independent cross-check alone incorrectly upgraded the aggregate status from RANGE_ONLY.
Forward model alone incorrectly upgraded the aggregate status from RANGE_ONLY.
S11 multi-method support without a validated S09 horizon incorrectly produced aggregate MULTI_METHOD_VALIDATED.

changes: Replaced OR-based partial-readiness logic with explicit AND requirements.
Required the validated S09 horizon before aggregate MULTI_METHOD_VALIDATED.
Added status_evidence and unmet_status_requirements for auditable status derivation.

guards: Multi-method S11 without a complete S09 horizon remains PARTIALLY_VALIDATED.

acceptance_interpretation: S12 validates shared valuation behavior across six controlled business-model modules; synthetic fixtures are not company research or investment conclusions.

The five preserved public-company contracts demonstrate safe no-input fallback and no synthetic backfill; they do not claim that complete real-company S10 or S11 analyst assumptions are already available.
Aggregate Valuation Status is now stricter than either the S10 or S11 component status.
Status validation does not replace probability governance, return validation, Gate 4 eligibility, or User approval.
Phase C S09-S12 is accepted without enabling target prices, position sizing, portfolio action, or trade execution from unsupported evidence.
scope_boundary: S12 does not auto-select real peers, acquire licensed consensus, or create analyst-owned forecasts for a public company.
S12 does not convert synthetic acceptance values into real-company reports.
Gate 4 remains private, local, and human-approved.
A future unseen-company run must still preserve the blind-test protocol and may return a safe missing or unsupported-module state.

exact_next_starting_point.name: Gate 4 Portfolio Constraint Set
exact_next_starting_point.first_action: Consume only a fresh eligible Gate 3 contract and implement the local private constraint set for issuer, correlated, sector, country, liquidity, downside, risk-budget, holding-period, opportunity-cost, and permitted-hedge capacity without inventing policy defaults.
